# Generated by /bootstrap. Do not edit: changes are overwritten at boot.
# OpenPERouter FRR Router Pod: FRR and reloader share the perouter network namespace.

[Unit]
Description=OpenPERouter FRR Router Pod
Documentation=https://github.com/openperouter

[Quadlet]
DefaultDependencies=false

[Pod]
PodName=routerpod
HostName=%H
Network=ns:/var/run/netns/perouter
PodmanArgs=--share=+pid

[Service]
Restart=on-failure
TimeoutStopSec=70
ExecStartPre=-/usr/sbin/ip netns add perouter
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/ip netns exec perouter ip link set lo up
